name: On the Rocks
description: On the Rocks isn't just a restaurant. It's a destination. Perched on Blouberg Strand with uninterrupted views of Table Mountain and Robben Island, we offer elegant coastal dining from sunrise breakfasts to romantic sunset dinners. A local favourite and must-visit tourist spot, known for signature dishes, Bertha Wines, and the most beautiful views in Cape Town.

items.name: The Florentine
items.description: Smoked trout, baby spinach, and poached eggs adorned with Mornay sauce and salmon roe, served on sourdough.

items.name: The Jonkershuis
items.description: Crispy pork belly, poached egg, and basil pesto served on toasted sourdough.

items.name: Traditional Ocean Fry-Up
items.description: Two eggs cooked to your liking, crispy bacon, pork sausage, grilled tomato, sautéed mushrooms, served with artisanal sourdough.

items.name: Smashed Avo & Feta Toast
items.description: Smashed avocado on toasted sourdough topped with beetroot hummus, crumbled feta, and toasted pumpkin seeds.

items.name: Brioche French Toast
items.description: Thick-cut brioche French toast served with caramelized bananas, toasted pecans, and pure maple syrup.

items.name: West Coast Oysters
items.description: Freshly shucked West Coast oysters served on crushed ice with lemon wedges and chili pineapple mignonette.

items.name: Pan-Seared Garlic & Chili Prawns
items.description: Succulent tiger prawns seared in garlic, chili, and white wine butter, served with grilled sourdough.

items.name: Klein Karoo Venison Carpaccio
items.description: Paper-thin venison carpaccio drizzled with truffle mayo, capers, micro herbs, and shaved parmesan.

items.name: West Coast Mussels in Wine Marinière
items.description: Steamed West Coast mussels in a creamy white wine, garlic, and parsley broth with crispy French baguette.

items.name: Grilled Halloumi & Chorizo
items.description: Pan-fried Cypriot halloumi and spicy chorizo drizzled with hot honey and fresh oregano.

items.name: Grand Ocean Seafood Platter
items.description: Luxe seafood feast featuring crayfish, grilled tiger prawns, linefish fillets, fried calamari, and mussels in garlic butter.

items.name: Dry-Aged Beef Fillet
items.description: 250g prime dry-aged beef fillet topped with herb tarragon butter, roasted vine tomatoes, and potato fondant.

items.name: Cape Malay Seafood Curry
items.description: Aromatic mild coconut curry with prawns, fresh linefish, and calamari, served with basmati rice and poppadums.

items.name: Herb & Mint Crusted Rack of Lamb
items.description: Oven-roasted Karoo lamb rack with a fresh herb crust, dauphinoise potatoes, and rich rosemary reduction.

items.name: Traditional Seafood Paella
items.description: Saffron-infused rice brimming with West Coast mussels, tiger prawns, calamari rings, and local linefish.

items.name: Pan-Seared Local Linefish
items.description: Freshly caught Kingklip fillet pan-seared with lemon herb butter, crushed new potatoes, and roasted baby vegetables.

items.name: Slow-Braised Springbok Shank
items.description: Tender braised game shank in rich port wine reduction, served over sweet potato mash and glazed carrots.

items.name: Decadent Dark Chocolate Fondant
items.description: Warm chocolate cake with a molten lava center, served with house-made vanilla bean gelato.

items.name: Vanilla Bean Panna Cotta
items.description: Silky smooth Madagascar vanilla panna cotta topped with wild berry coulis and fresh mint.

items.name: Classic Vanilla Bean Crème Brûlée
items.description: Rich custard base topped with a brittle caramelized sugar crust and butter shortbread cookie.

items.name: Artisanal Sorbet & Gelato Trio
items.description: Selection of refreshing seasonal fruit sorbets (passion fruit, mango, raspberry) with berry coulis.

items.name: Aperol Spritz
items.description: Refreshing Aperol spritz with prosecco, soda, and fresh orange slice served on an oceanfront table.

items.name: Blouberg Sunset Mojito
items.description: Classic white rum mojito with crushed ice, fresh mint, lime juice, and sugarcane syrup against the sunset.

items.name: Atlantic Blue Botanical Gin & Tonic
items.description: Local craft gin infused with blue pea flower, premium tonic, and fresh rosemary sprig.

items.name: Bertha Reserve Wines (Glass)
items.description: Estate Sauvignon Blanc or Pinotage paired perfectly with coastal seafood and grills.

testimonials.text: The view alone is worth the trip. Best restaurant view in Cape Town.
testimonials.author: WhaleTales Blog

testimonials.text: A must-visit for postcard finders, tourists, and locals alike.
